{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for duplicate order_id
duplicate_orders = sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate order_ids: {duplicate_orders}')

# Check unique values in status column
print('\nUnique values in status:')
print(sales_df['status'].unique())

# Check unique values in channel column
print('\nUnique values in channel:')
print(sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check revenue column for non-numeric values
print('\nRevenue values:')
print(sales_df['revenue'].unique())"}
